description_en: Migrates a contiguous Elastic IP Address (EIP) group to an IP address pool
description_zh: 将连续EIP组迁移至IP地址池
name: TransformEipSegmentToPublicIpAddressPool

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the contiguous EIP group to migrate
parameters.help_zh: 要进行迁移的连续EIP组的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the contiguous EIP group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 连续EIP组所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IP address pool instance.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
地址池实例的名称。

长度为0-128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the IP address pool instance.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
地址池实例的描述。

长度为0-256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the IP address pool belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

PublicIpAddressPoolId.description_en: The instance ID of the IP address pool

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the IP address pool belongs
